All signs.voice_body: STOP letting invisible power struggles simmer—Mars opposite Pluto on 2 October 2026 is a storm of assertive energy and deep transformation. It signals a clash between your drive and hidden forces, like a work dispute or a personal belief being challenged. Acknowledge the tension, then set a firm boundary or negotiate openly. Take a moment to write down one boundary you’ll assert today.
